Costume fete season is here 🎭 The rules, so you don't learn them the hard way:

1️⃣ Wine-proof the costume — if you can't dance in it, it stays home
2️⃣ The mask works on everybody except security. Walk with ID 😂
3️⃣ Read the flyer — some fetes require costumes (Hallo-Whine at One77 Brooklyn does)
4️⃣ Ticket first, costume after. Tickets sell out, glitter doesn't.
